title: Kafka: Fix two mis-dissections in old message format.
description:
In the "old" message format, the length of "bytes" objects is described using a
uint32.  Commit 18bc35e3e5 brought a massive update to the Kafka protocol
support, but it accidentally changed the length of "bytes" objects to uint16,
which broke dissection of those older messages.  It also accidentally advanced
the offset between the "codec" and "timestamp type" fields of the Message
structure, but those values come from the same octet, so the offset should not
be advanced.  This change corrects both of these issues.

Also change the test for the existence of the timestamp field match the
documentation -- test that "magic" is greater than zero.

----

With this change, the capture file given to me by @martin.r.mathieson (see https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15186#note_1853773002) now dissects correctly and decompresses the Snappy-compressed segments.
